Based on the information provided, the VaxiQuick vaccine demonstrates a 70% efficacy rate in preventing mild cases and an 85% efficacy rate in preventing severe cases. This level of protection is reported to be consistent across all adult age groups. However, the data does not establish the vaccine's effectiveness in preventing the transmission of the disease to unvaccinated individuals, as this aspect has not been thoroughly studied.

Regarding your priority question: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically in the shells of oysters, mussels, and clams.
